title: Guitar session, with Larry at far right
description: The same gathering as VN-0003 and VN-0008, outside the matting-walled hooch: a soldier in fatigues with a holstered pistol leans against the wall at left, a man in a white shirt plays a sunburst archtop guitar on a folding chair, a man in a pale blue sport shirt stands with one foot up and a hand on a blind cord, and at far right, in a white T-shirt and white trousers with his hands on his hips, stands Larry.
